# Stage 11 Plan and Completed Todos

## Target

Prove that the Stage 10 obstruction disappears after replacing arbitrary
microscopic boundary data by a gauge-covariant coherent-staple collar, while
making no assumption about how frequently that collar occurs.

## Completed todos

- [x] Define coherence by the existence of a common staple center in the
  bi-invariant `SU(2)` metric.
- [x] Verify invariance under the endpoint gauge action.
- [x] Translate the conditional density by the common center.
- [x] Bound its reference energy by `m eta^2`.
- [x] Bound any target bad event from below by `rho^2`.
- [x] Prove the uniform small-time rate gap `rho^2-m eta^2`.
- [x] Derive the sufficient threshold `eta<rho/sqrt(m)`.
- [x] Prove that `{I,-I}` needs common radius `pi/2`.
- [x] Enumerate the commuting extremal family and recover its sharp scalar
  deviation.
- [x] Calibrate the Stage 09 parameter point.
- [x] Implement fail-closed tests and claim-level flags.
- [x] Record the missing collar-failure estimate as the next implication.

## Decision

Good-collar conditioning is viable at the small-time rate level.  Its missing
half is a volume-uniform charged activity estimate for incoherent collars.
